laws.rule: Wuyishan National Park rules (Fujian provincial regulation, in force 1 Oct 2024) ban camping, barbecues, climbing, exploring, smoking, fireworks and sky lanterns outside designated areas or routes, and swimming in the main stream of the Nine-Bend Stream (Jiuqu Xi).
laws.penalty_signal: Camping, climbing or exploring outside designated areas: CNY 1,000 to 10,000 (about A$213 to A$2,133). Swimming in the Nine-Bend Stream main stream: CNY 200 to 500 (about A$43 to A$107). Rate: A$1 = CNY 4.6877, RBA 30 Oct 2026.

laws.rule: The same regulation bars hunting, killing, selling, carrying or eating wild animals, and releasing animals, inside the park; and bars bringing in plants, soil or products carrying disease or pests.
laws.penalty_signal: Releasing wild animals: CNY 200 to 2,000, or 2,000 to 20,000 in serious cases (about A$43 to A$427, and A$427 to A$4,267).

laws.rule: Smoking or lighting a fire in a scenic area's fire-ban zone is banned. The management body gives a warning and orders it to stop (article 50).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 500 to 3,000 (about A$107 to A$640). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)

local-law.note: The regulation also lets the park's operators set a visitor reservation system based on a set visitor capacity. No current reservation requirement for foreign visitors was confirmed from an official page, so none is recorded.
